decision: Deploy client-side tokenization (Stripe.js) to eliminate merchant server PCI compliance
alternatives: Server-side card proxy vs Redirect payment gateway
criteria: Developer friction, security liability, conversion rate
rationale: Tokens keep raw card numbers off merchant servers, reducing PCI scope to SAQ A and eliminating data breach risk

decision: Underwrite merchant risk programmatically on platform balance sheet
alternatives: Mandatory 40-page upfront underwriting vs Instant automated activation
criteria: Speed to first transaction, developer conversion
rationale: Instant 5-minute activation creates unstoppable developer word-of-mouth wedge

decision: Implement flat 2.9% + 30¢ pricing with zero monthly maintenance or setup charges
alternatives: Tiered interchange-plus pricing vs Monthly SaaS subscription
rationale: Eliminates opaque pricing contracts and undercuts legacy total cost for startups
